messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Hindi, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Hindi line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
कि तू मुझे वहाँ ले चलें, जैसा तू अब कहा है, ताकि मैं संत पीटर का द्वार देख सकूँ और उन लोगों को जिन्हें तू इतना दुखी बनाता है»

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Mapping Table (Source → Hindi)**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word / Phrase | Back‑Translation | Status | |-------------|-----------------------|----------------------|-------------------|--------| | che | subordinating conjunction “that” | कि | that | OK | | tu | 2nd person singular pronoun (subject) | तू | you | OK | | mi | 1st person singular pronoun (object) | मुझे | me | OK | | meni | verb “to lead, guide” | ले चलें | lead (go) | OK | | là | adverb of place “there” | वहाँ | there | OK | | dov' | relative adverb “where” | जैसा | as/like | **WRONG** (does not convey “where”) | | or | adverb of time “now” | अब | now | OK | | dicesti | verb “said” (past) | कहा है | said (has said) | **GRAMMAR** (auxiliary *है* added) | | sì | adverb “so (that)” | ताकि | so that | OK | | ch'io | 1st person singular pronoun (subject) | मैं | I | OK | | veggia | verb “see” (subjunctive) | देख | see | **GRAMMAR** (modal *सकूँ* added) | | la | definite article (feminine) | — *(omitted)* | — | **UNNECESSARY** (article not required in Hindi) | | porta | noun “gate” | द्वार | gate | OK | | di | preposition “of” (genitive) | का | of | OK | | san | honorific “saint” | संत | saint | OK | | Pietro | proper name “Peter” | पीटर | Peter | OK | | e | coordinating conjunction “and” | और | and | OK | | color | demonstrative pronoun “those” | उन | those | OK | | cui | relative pronoun “whom/which” | जिन्हें | whom | OK | | tu | 2nd person singular pronoun (subject) | तू | you | OK | | fai | verb “make, cause” | बनाता | makes/causes | OK | | cotanto | degree adverb “so much” | इतना | so much | OK | | mesti | adjective “afflicted, sad” | दुखी | afflicted | OK |
---
### Items to Note
- **WRONG**: *dov'* was rendered as *जैसा* (“as”), which does not preserve the locative sense “where”. - **GRAMMAR**: - *dicesti* required the auxiliary *है* to form the perfect in Hindi. - *veggia* required the modal verb *सकूँ* to express “may see”. - **UNNECESSARY**: *la* (the definite article) is naturally omitted in Hindi. - **No MISSING** source items; every source token appears in the Hindi translation (either directly or via a necessary grammatical addition).

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Hindi script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Hindi text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- **Line 133** - Original: कि तू मुझे वहाँ ले चलें, जैसा तू अब कहा है, - Issue: **WRONG** – “जैसा” does not convey the locative “where”. - Corrected: **कि तू मुझे वहाँ ले चलें, जहाँ तू अब कहा था,**
- **Line 134** - Original: ताकि मैं संत पीटर का द्वार देख सकूँ - Issue: none - Corrected: **no change**
- **Line 135** - Original: और उन लोगों को जिन्हें तू इतना दुखी बनाता है» - Issue: none - Corrected: **no change**
